newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit Bank dips to all-time low.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit Bank dips to all-time low.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd fell to an all-time low on Monday morning due to lingering worries about the effectiveness of the bank's restructuring plan released last week, brokers said.
At 0155 GMT, the share price was 16 yen lower at 174, a lifetime low. The previous low was 177 yen, marked on February 5, 1997.
Volume was 6.574 million shares, the second heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Last Tuesday, Nippon Credit Bank announced restructuring measures aimed at restoring its financial health. They included halting overseas operations and selling its Tokyo headquarters.
